rule: the mark looks at what you look at
title: Orbit Index
description: A dense, keyboard-first index of all 30 projects on a calm dark ground. A halftone mark turns toward the focused row, and a preview glides beside it.
signature: The halftone sphere from the site's favicon, drawn live in canvas 2D, turns its light and its ring gap toward the focused row and takes that project's accent. A leader line joins the row to its preview, and a year track in every row shows when the work happened.
holdback: Original, 6 of 10. The page is a near relative of designeer.xyz: dark ground, a dot sphere, dense rows and a slash to search. The year track, the leader line and the favicon-derived mark are its own grammar, but a reviewer can still read it as a better-organised version of the reference. Hooks is also 6: the mark is 120 px and its turn is subtle, so the memorable moment depends on the visitor moving through the list.
